items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Charlie Hampton. Charlie Hampton. No, not Charlie Hampton. [INTERVIEWEE] I'm talking about Benny.

ctx.x: I know what you're talking about, what you call living on Broadway Street out there. I think he died too. No, he didn't. He worked at the Army Bay State, he played a couple of times, playing time with Pete Bocci, he used it, what is that? What is that? Charlie Hampton. Charlie Hampton. No, not Charlie Hampton.
